newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Gintian loses 27.4 mln yuan in 96.
newsitem.headline: China Gintian loses 27.4 mln yuan in 96.

text.p: Shenzhen-based Gintian Industry (Group) Co Ltd recorded a net loss of 27.36 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Per-share loss reached 0.08 yuan in 1996 and turnover was 670.23 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
For 1995, the company posted net profits of 10.22 million yuan based on internatinnal standards.
Under Chinese standards, 1995 net profits were 43.5 million yuan.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and resume in the aftennoon, it said.
